standard_prerequisites.name: Basic properties of Fitting ideals, in particular their behaviour under base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-fitting-ideal-basics (Stacks tag 07ZA), invoked at proof lines 8858-8860
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that IC is the Fitting ideal of C/J tensor_A C, which is the base change step that makes the splitting argument possible.

standard_prerequisites.name: A map between etale algebras is etale, and a surjective flat finitely presented algebra map splits off a direct summand
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemmas labelled algebra-lemma-map-between-etale (Stacks tag 00U7) at proof lines 8864-8865 and algebra-lemma-surjective-flat-finitely-presented (Stacks tag 00U8) at proof lines 8866-8868
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply that the multiplication map is etale, hence flat, and that the resulting surjection C tensor_A C_h -> C_h splits, giving the direct sum decomposition used to factor the ideal.

core_obligations: Use the basic properties of Fitting ideals to identify IC with the Fitting ideal of C/J tensor_A C, and note that the multiplication map C tensor_A C -> C has a section (proof lines 8858-8863).
Show that the multiplication map C tensor_A C_h -> C_h is etale, hence flat, because C -> C tensor_A C is etale at every prime in the image of Spec(C_h) under the section (proof lines 8862-8865).
Split the base changed ring: since the surjective flat finitely presented map C tensor_A C_h -> C_h has a section, one has C tensor_A C_h = C_h direct sum C' as C_h-algebras (proof lines 8866-8868).

Tensor the splitting with C/J to obtain (C/J) tensor_A C_h = (C_h/J_h) direct sum C'/I', and read off IC_h = JJ' with J' = Fit_0(C'/I') viewed as a C_h-module, noting that finite generation of J gives finite generation of I and J' (proof lines 8869-8872).
proof_roadmap: Base change the Fitting ideal and use the multiplication section (proof lines 8858-8863).
Make the multiplication map etale and hence flat and split the ring (proof lines 8862-8868).
Read the factoring of the ideal off the splitting, with the finite generation statement (proof lines 8869-8872).
difficulty_reason: For a finite locally free ring map A -> C of rank d, an element h with C_h etale over A, and an ideal J of C, the lemma asserts that I = Fit_0(C/J), viewed as a finite A-module, satisfies IC_h = JJ' for some ideal J' of C_h, and that I and J' are finitely generated whenever J is (statement lines 8848-8855). The proof computes I after base change: IC is the Fitting ideal of C/J tensor_A C, using the basics of Fitting ideals, so it suffices to split the ring C tensor_A C_h along the multiplication section. The section shows that C -> C tensor_A C is etale at every prime in the image of Spec(C_h), hence the multiplication map C tensor_A C_h -> C_h is etale and in particular flat, and a finite locally free surjection with a section then splits the source as a direct sum of C_h-algebras (proof lines 8857-8868). Tensoring with C/J and reading off the zeroth Fitting ideal of each summand gives IC_h = JJ' with J' the Fitting ideal of the complementary summand, and finite generation is inherited from J (proof lines 8869-8872). Recognising that the section splits the base changed ring and thereby factors the Fitting ideal is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
